description: A seated Buddha statue garlanded with orange and red marigolds sits on a low wooden table in an open dusty field at dusk. A lantern glows on the table beside two microphones with cables, and scattered papers and white cloths lie on the table and ground. Flower petals and marigold chains cover the earth, with tents and smoke on the distant horizon. No people are visible.
reason: The card asks for a vast crowd before a stage with hands pressed together toward a garlanded Buddha statue. The painting has the garlanded Buddha and the stage-like table, but no crowd, so it reads as the aftermath of a gathering rather than the conversion itself. It could plausibly stand for any Buddhist ceremony, so the subject match is uncertain.
